members.name: Lanthouchung Gonmei
members.bio: Lanthouchung Gonmei, a dynamic Final-year Architecture student at Pune University, Maharashtra with a deep passion for design and a unique flair for Minimalist and Brutalist Architecture. With a passion for leadership, he has served as the Publicity Secretary of Manipur Students Association Pune and as the National Outreach Coordinator for the 67th Year of NASA India (National Association of Students of Architecture).A minimalist design enthusiast at heart, he seeks simplicity and functionality in his work, drawing inspiration from the raw, unadorned beauty of Brutalism. His interests lies in Urban Studies, Planning, and Housing solutions for tribal and marginalized communities. This passion has been further shaped by his involvement with various NGOs. He currently serves as the Information and Publicity Secretary for the North East Community Organization Pune. Beyond academics, his love for travel fuels his curiosity, enabling him to explore diverse architectural styles and cultural landscapes.

members.name: Macmillan Wahengbam
members.bio: Macmillan Wahengbam is a dedicated physics student pursuing an M.Sc. in Physics at NIT Meghalaya, with academic interests in space science, astrophysics, rocket science, plasma physics, nanomaterials, and cosmology. He is focused on developing strong analytical, problem-solving, and practical skills through academic and research experiences. In 2025, he completed a Summer Research Internship at NIT Manipur, gaining exposure to research-oriented work and scientific methodologies. Beyond academics, he serves as a Public Relations Officer and contributes to the Creative Team of MitSna Foundation, working in communication and graphic design. He is also a member of the Manipur Astronomical Society, supporting initiatives that encourage astronomy and scientific awareness among students and the community.
